product.name: nao AI Code Editor
product.description: An AI-powered code editor designed for data teams to create, run, and manage SQL and Python data pipelines integrated with data warehouses and dbt projects.

identifier.value: nao AI Agent for Data Quality and Testing

product.name: nao AI Agent for Data Quality and Testing
product.description: An AI agent that automates data quality checks, compares development and production data tables, and runs defined tests to ensure data integrity.

product.name: nao Integration with dbt
product.description: Integration with dbt projects enabling preview of models, smart autocomplete for model columns, and visibility into column-level lineage within the IDE.

product.name: Enterprise Deployment with Enterprise-Hosted LLMs
product.description: An enterprise offering that enables deployment of nao with enterprise-hosted large language models (LLMs) and enhanced data security within the customer's infrastructure.
